sheets.name: sea_tiles
sheets.description: Opaque 8x16 tiles. Tile order inside each tag: bg = bg_light, bg_mid, bg_deep; bg_ray = bg_ray; sky = sky; surface = surface_0, surface_1; rock = rock_fill, rock_top, rock_under; wall_light = wall_l_light, wall_r_light; wall_mid = wall_l_mid, wall_r_mid; ledge_mid = ledge_tr, ledge_br, ledge_tl, ledge_bl; wall_deep = wall_l_deep, wall_r_deep, wall_l_weed, wall_r_weed; sand = sand_top, sand_fill; coral = coral_a, coral_b; weed = weed_0, weed_1; ruins = ruin_block, ruin_col, ruin_cap; pipe = pipe_h, pipe_v; cable_anchor = anchor_top, anchor_bot; vent = vent_0, vent_1, vent_2; siphon_rim = rim_l, rim_r, throat_top, throat. Water bands bg_light/bg_mid/bg_deep are flat (change band per tile row going down); wall/ledge/prop tiles carry the band in their name and must sit in that band. Walls: wall_l_* has rock on the left (water to the right) and is full rock on its top/bottom rows, so it stacks directly on rock_fill/rock_top/rock_under. Ledges are 2 tiles tall: rock_top...ledge_tr over rock_under...ledge_br (mirror: ledge_tl/ledge_bl); use rock_fill in the wall column at ledge rows. Props (coral, weed, vent) stand on sand_top/rock_top. Siphon exit in the floor row: rim_l, throat_top x4, rim_r, with rock_fill | throat x4 | rock_fill below.

sheets.name: sea_cable
sheets.anchor: tile-aligned: place on the 8x16 grid; frames touch the frame edges on purpose so segments chain (vertical: stack between anchor_top/anchor_bot tiles; horizontal: side by side)
sheets.description: Electrified cable hazard. off / off_h = unpowered (safe), spark / spark_h = live (harmful), 60-80 ms per frame. Suggested cycle: 1.5 s off, 1 s live; flash one spark frame as warning 250 ms before going live. Collision box: vertical cols 2-5, horizontal rows 6-9.

sheets.name: sea_mine
sheets.anchor: sphere centre (8,11) in frames 1 and 3; bob frames move the sphere -1/0/+1 row while the chain end stays on the bottom row
sheets.description: Moored naval mine. bob: 4 frames, 150 ms, red light blinks (on in frames 1-2). chain: 16x24 chain segment that stacks vertically under the mine down to the floor/ledge. Contact radius about 5 columns x 9 rows around the sphere centre; on contact spawn sea_explosion centred on the sphere centre.

sheets.name: sea_explosion
sheets.description: Underwater blast for mines, drones and torpedoes: flash, fireball, fireball breaking into a bubble cloud, dispersing bubbles (60/80/100/120 ms, play once). Harmful in frames 1-2 only. No outline (bright FX).

sheets.name: sea_drone
sheets.description: Underwater security drone (32x16 so it reads next to the 64-wide swimmers). swim: 4 frames (ducted propeller spin, searchlight beam flicker, lamp dims on frame 4), 90 ms. fire: 2 frames (80/120 ms); spawn sea_torpedo on fire frame 1 with its tail at drone (25,12) (tube muzzle).

sheets.name: sea_torpedo
sheets.anchor: centre (8,4); nose at column 13, faces right
sheets.description: Drone torpedo projectile with bubble trail, fly: 2 frames 90 ms. Hitbox cols 5-13 rows 2-5.

sheets.name: sea_pickups
sheets.anchor: centre (4,8); bob of 1 row is baked into the frames
sheets.description: medkit: 4 frames 150 ms (bob + glint); oxygen: 4 frames 150 ms (yellow tank, bubbles rising from the valve). The medkit outline uses columns 0 and 7 (EDGE warning is expected).

sheets.name: sea_siphon
sheets.anchor: bottom-centre (24,31) = centre of the hole; place with its bottom row on the bottom row of the rim tile row (sprite y = rim row y - 16) and x = rim_l x, so it spans rim_l + 4 throat_top + rim_r
sheets.description: Level exit: whirlpool pouring down into the siphon in the sea floor. swirl: 4 frames 90 ms (streaks wrap around the funnel, foam and debris orbit the lip). Suggested gameplay: within ~3 tiles the vortex pulls the heroine towards (24,31); touching the throat triggers the transition (she is flushed out into the oasis pool of the next level).

notes: Vertical scroll top to bottom, 20 tiles wide. Depth bands: row with sky + surface tiles at the top, then bg_light, bg_mid, bg_deep; switch bands on whole tile rows (never mix inside a row except where a prop/wall tile of that band sits). Animated tiles: surface (2 frames, 150 ms), weed (2), vent (3, bubbles loop every 3 frames). Suggested oxygen: bubble vents refill slowly when the heroine overlaps the 2 tiles above a vent; oxygen tank pickup refills fully. Buoyancy: the heroine drifts up slowly when idle. Hazards: live cables and mines hurt on contact, drone torpedoes explode on walls. The stand-in swimmer in the mockup is the existing frogman_swim frame. mockup_sea.png is a 160x352 slice (no HUD); mockup_sea_siphon.png is the bottom of the level with the exit (HUD strip left black).
